purpose: Provide background that explains the following situation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + ので; noun / な-adjective + なので.
I will wait inside because it is raining.
Since tomorrow is a day off, I will sleep in.
I was late because the roads were busy.
Present a reason as an assertion or background
formation: Plain clause + ので; noun / な-adjective + なので.
restrictions: Often frames a reason as background; it does not remove all personal judgment.
mistake: Use なので after a noun, not noun + ので directly.
